take_homes: A text can be correct and still useless, so you need one check for 'is it true' and one for 'is it good'.
The checker has to stay the same while the writer improves, and a good score only means the checker found nothing.
Agents can write internal mails and reports, and I can set the rule and read the result once in a while.

monday.move: Try the mail check on my weekly depot note, if the data is a file I already have
monday.when: later this week, if there is time
monday.stop_condition: If it needs IT to export something, I drop it
monday.blocker: No time, and the reporting data sits in a system I can't export from without IT

misconception.why: The example was internal mail like risk notes and project updates, not customer chat, so I saw AI could be used for my own work. I'm not convinced about operations proper, and nothing here touched a shift plan or a delivery report.

one_line: The part where it writes my depot note and checks it was useful, but the first half is a lot of English text and software talk.
